digitalocean.name: DigitalOcean

charge_timing.meter_starts: INSTANT - the second droplet is created
charge_timing.meter_stops: ONLY when droplet is DESTROYED (not powered off)
charge_timing.billing_granularity: Partial hours rounded UP to full hour
charge_timing.accrual_method: Hourly - cost accumulates every hour droplet exists
charge_timing.charge_date: Same day as invoice - auto-charged to card

critical_timing_rules: CREATE = START BILLING: Charges begin the INSTANT you create
DESTROY = STOP BILLING: This is the ONLY way to stop charges
POWER OFF ≠ FREE: Powered-off droplets STILL COST MONEY
PARTIAL HOUR = FULL HOUR: 1 minute = charged for full hour
CREDIT BURNS IN REAL-TIME: Check balance regularly

anthropic.name: Anthropic (Claude)

charge_timing.meter_starts: Per API call - when request is processed
charge_timing.accrual_method: Per-request - cost calculated per API call
charge_timing.invoice_date: Monthly (1st of month for previous month)
charge_timing.subscription_charge: Claude Code Pro: Monthly on signup anniversary

critical_timing_rules: IMMEDIATE ACCRUAL: Each API call adds to monthly bill
OUTPUT COSTS MORE: Output tokens 5x cost of input
CONTEXT = COST: Longer conversations = more input tokens = more cost
SUBSCRIPTION: Claude Code Pro charges monthly regardless of usage

openai.name: OpenAI

charge_timing.meter_starts: Per API call - when request is processed
charge_timing.accrual_method: PREPAID DEDUCTION - credits deducted in real-time
charge_timing.credit_check: BEFORE each request - fails if insufficient

critical_timing_rules: PREPAID ONLY: Must have credits BEFORE making requests
REAL-TIME DEDUCTION: Credits deducted immediately per call
ZERO CREDITS = FAIL: API returns error when credits exhausted
NO GRACE PERIOD: Unlike postpaid, service stops immediately

groq.name: Groq

rate_limits.reset_time: Rolling window for RPM, midnight UTC for daily

critical_timing_rules: FREE: $0 cost always
RATE LIMITED: Hit limit = requests rejected until reset
RPM RESETS: Every 60 seconds
DAILY RESETS: Midnight UTC

google_ai.name: Google AI (Gemini)
critical_timing_rules: FREE: $0 cost in free tier
HIGHER LIMITS: 2x Groq's RPM
USE SECOND: After Groq rate limited, fall back here

polymarket.name: Polymarket

charge_timing.meter_stops: On market resolution OR position sale

critical_timing_rules: NO TRADING FEES: 0% - only gas
GAS IMMEDIATE: Small fee paid on each transaction
FUNDS LOCKED: Capital tied up until resolution
RESOLUTION = SETTLEMENT: No action needed, auto-settles

coingecko.name: CoinGecko API
critical_timing_rules: FREE: No cost
RATE LIMITED: Will block temporarily if exceeded

github.name: GitHub
critical_timing_rules: FREE: No cost for current usage pattern
ACTIONS: 2000 free minutes/month, then blocked

digitalocean.description: Charges accrue every hour, invoice monthly

polymarket.description: Gas paid per trade, funds locked until resolution
